routes.summary: PR670 is the retained minimal hardening lane for the already-integrated adapters.MistralInference transport. In addition to its non-finite JSON fences, bind provider-reported model identity exactly to the requested model: require a present bounded model field and model_returned == self.model before receipt creation. The current main/PR transport only requires a non-empty returned model, so gateway/provider substitution can weaken provenance.
routes.required_revalidation: Refresh PR670 head and current main before the next write; preserve its single existing Mistral transport and strict JSON changes; add negatives for missing and mismatched provider model plus exact-match control; do not import the duplicate Mistral transport from PR629. Run focused transport regressions in an authorized isolated surface before promotion; no real-token/OCI/runtime credit from source structure alone.
